rules.sentence: A perinephric abscess is usually a complication of urologic infection which results from fat necrosis.
More than 3/4 of perinephric abscesses are now due to complications of urinary tract infections
Perinephric abscess results from perirenal fat necrosis.
A perinephric abscess is usually a complication of urologic infection.
Most perirenal abscesses were due to prolonged bacteremia with Staphylococcus aureusfollowed by hematogenous seeding before the era of antibiotics.[1]
More than 75% of perinephric abscesses are now due to complications of urinary tract infection.
